sentences.text: On January 10, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented left wrist pain 6/10 and that a splint was fitted.
On February 8, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 5/10 and "Continue splint."
On March 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 5/10 and "Begin hand therapy."
On April 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 4/10 and "Hand therapy ongoing."
On May 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 4/10 and "Grip strength improving."
On June 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 3/10 and grip strength 70% of right side.
On July 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 3/10 and "Therapy continues."
On August 9, 2028, Thistlewick Orthopedics (Dr. Beatrix Quillon) documented pain 2/10 and that discharge planning was discussed.
